| Untitled Document
There's an indigenous group of people called the Kuna in Panama that are a fascinating story in longevity as well as stellar cardiovascular health, and lack of metabolic diseases like Diabetes, etc.

The Kuna people drink an average of 5 cups of a type of cocoa every day and they have 9x lower rates of cardiovascular problems than the rest of the world.

High blood pressure is also almost non-existent in these people, yet they actually consume a good amount of salt.

And cancer rates are an astonishing 15x lower than the rest of the world. And they don't eat much leafy green vegetables either like most Americans try to stuff down.

They also consume a fair amount of sugar, yet their arteries are clean as a whistle, and blood sugar and blood pressure are normal and healthy.

But researchers found that it's NOT their genetics, because members who moved to cities and started eating modern processed foods suffered all the same health problems as most of the world (Diabetes, obesity, heart disease, etc).

In today's article, you'll find out the Kuna's longevity secrets, and what exact type of cocoa they drink that could be a huge part of their incredible health...

> [The Kuna drink 5 cups of a type of a cacao drink daily](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Mjh9AAwAAAAAAZL3buuaaY1OH4uEhLBL3365tMCiaGLh8jyyIVlf9K91_DabI0Cb6JJIH8hQBojwfVpcrB4-AsGullaAZnqZ5eh1MjlZ_RW_w_PdsC1X) (and they have clean arteries, 9x lower heart disease rates, and healthy blood pressure and blood sugar)

This type of cacao they drink has also been shown to have up to 63x the antioxidant levels of broccoli and kale.

These particular flavanols (a type of polyphenol) in this type of cacao are shown in studies to improve heart health, lower blood pressure, boost blood flow throughout the body, improve blood sugar, and even improve your gut health by diversifying your microbiome.

Even more exciting is that the article will show you a study where cacao drinkers had nearly DOUBLE the levels of GLP-1 in their body within 2 hours of drinking cacao than people that didn't drink the cacao.

And as you know, GLP-1 in your body can help you slim down faster, so this is also a really cool benefit of drinking cacao, but strength and polyphenol levels matter as you'll see below...

[Read this article to see the type of cacao](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5Mjh9AAwAAAAAAZL3buub3EyCg7CuwjHif-7z0nIMA0JSUR8w-G-8ew1BQCnXVE20-2ZfGtN2pCJT3gv-RNEAM3MjhwSy5P-jG8iMX6KMKnoDYLQD7G0M) that has all of these powerful benefits. Hint: It's NOT your average grocery store cocoa.

# Sunday, July 5, 2026
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1994, Amazon was incorporated. The company was originally set up in Washington State as an online bookstore, but it would soon grow into one of the world's most influential technology giants. [See the original website here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uwyAUxfGnwZut62sCycDQxVu6drRwuMS34iMCEit9-sp9he5HP-n8v67L1XLgdP-0kUzzeUm010CtUVluFGgttnFOteVCkeJKJdm2IKDqQfdwWpzl8F5k54wnQpo6MqM-TygVyku3GRi1lNPFW3_TZJVc6axwotV6GJWf1o7NoYGG0wgjSD1c_AgOQDnnzhoRhQRy3HIZvjOntpEP7_yiMtxy7ILZWntUMX0InAXO-74PLyqVc4rPSs94rATOGx8X3n32Amcb7U9O_U5r5UZdMe6xcwhclRYS7tFy-MPbv4q8DP4GAAD__6FzdrQ).

Today's issue of _The Flyover_ is a shortened holiday edition to allow _The Flyover _staff to enjoy the Fourth of July weekend with friends and family. Our regular edition will return on Tuesday. We hope everyone is having a safe and happy weekend! America just turned 250, and we invited the entire world to the party. For years, the world has been told that this country is angry, divided, and not what it used to be. Then over a million international visitors poured into our cities this summer for the World Cup, and they are seeing something completely different. **Whatever happened to Sarah Palin?** Sarah Palin was a small-town mayor and first-term governor of Alaska with approval ratings that at one point topped 80% when John McCain chose her as his 2008 running mate, making her the first woman on a Republican presidential ticket. She electrified the GOP convention as a self-described "hockey mom," but a tough Katie Couric interview and Tina Fey's devastating SNL impression, featuring the famous made-up quote, "_I can see Russia from my house_ ," defined her nationally before she could start. Palin was a good sport about it, even appearing on SNL herself. [Here's a backstage look.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2unTAQxfHVmM7IzDVfhYs0dC9tSjTgASYx9pU9Ad3dR2QLr_5LPx2dX1_zF3LguP_Ek5xsaY50l0AilOeVAi0ZhVMskjKddC6UI8oMBjptem3a2SOHz2wr7zYioFdFrumHF9gO7FgdzhokaAfvG7_a1m8jIA22w2UwzULjULF7NNObtjGNsX09bo3xxnTe-6EHAGUNeZaU69-Joxy0hU-6KNdrOqvgDpF3Ua8fCiYF033fdVzWpymYCsrf7PGjI--H6MAXKZgu9pSeGoNecP1TBHfS-2PGlHXBjId-Y-CoLy4sRcEEfWsGa6vs_PvmELh0vbJmP5HD_yHyrfcuB_8CAAD__6h3hOs) But beyond the laughs, Palin reshaped the Republican playbook. Her distrust of the "lamestream media," her rallies that crackled with populist anger, and her ability to connect with voters who felt ignored by Washington all presaged the movement that Donald Trump would ride to the White House eight years later. After the McCain-Palin ticket lost, Palin resigned her governorship in 2009 with more than a year left in her term, then reinvented herself as a bestselling author, Fox News contributor, and [reality TV star on TLC's _Sarah Palin's Alaska_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFuqzAQheGnMbugYTzBZOHFla7SVdpuqqorZOJxcGVwZCYg3r5KX6Hbc6Rv8X9e-ouLKc63VzexlZD7mbclsQiX_sqJh-Ik5nmRXHjiaeAyO-kRsD2AOcCx9y6mvafK28CMrCu2jek0Uot0qkZLA5EeSHeByZMJAcwR2Q-mMzqgOVXRPjUwcGygATL1KTTgAVrvfWcQURGwj5JL_Z3jLCOHtOeVS33NU5XsKHJflP6n8KzwvG1bveeHPAZ-_s_FyXVU-rwq_T-_feHjfd0_Xm5Vsf6-xZTi0hpFcJtcTL-k_KnDavEnAAD__wZZcRg). Off camera, things were rockier. Her marriage to high-school sweetheart Todd ended in divorce after 31 years, and her children's struggles with the law and the tabloids became a recurring subplot that never quite left the headlines. She tried for a political comeback, but it never arrived. In 2022, she lost twice to Democrat Mary Peltola for Alaska's lone House seat, and her long-running defamation lawsuit against _The New York Times_ ended in defeat in 2025. Today, Palin, 62 and divorced, calls herself a "Sovereign Single Mama" [on social media](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOqzAQgOHTmC5oGDuYFC5eQ5fXbokcZgizMjYyo6DcfpW9wva_vuL_uk_3KEny83_cOOhSpsznkViV6zRz4keNKiUfWipvvD245qgTAvYX8Be4ThQlvSfXUFiYkW3DofODRdejuzVr6MHOsDjs8BoZZjtYeuAAvJAjT7ZrJHw08HDtoAPn29vSAQH0RDR4RDQOmERLbb-LZF15Se_y4trOZWtSWFX3w9h_BkeD43mereRD47PG7VMYHI9Y47rHJPnmDY5NDbSfkpIcvTcOnluU9Ivpnw68Av4EAAD__4ZZb0E) and says she'd love a role in the Trump administration but hasn't been asked. ## Arlington's Parade Marks 150 and 250
Downtown Arlington's Independence Day parade, [the largest in Texas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykzz1ywyAQxfHTiM4aQHyIgiKNO6dNySCzkkhWwgMb27p9xr5CDvDe_P5fl3CJGfO-fMYNPD3nEnZ4NAQiqIHgGdsW60_7_sVDzVhKarFiDpJLc-L2xHVIMeMRFEt-4skJBl7YcZDKKSHZ6l2c5GhE1BocmKRMuo7OzjKZpLWLE8v-dcYt10LwYeC9ddqoSY9uHo2bhOsUh5Sp1J5WeJNmPModan8tG0O_Et1aN3x08tzJ84u3L1R2RWtf6tLJM6s-3R4ZMTdjO8WXLWZ8j-l_yXcv_wIAAP__qJNqdg), rolled off Saturday morning as the city celebrated its 150th birthday alongside America's 250th. More than 100 entries—floats, car clubs, and every Arlington high school band—wound through downtown and the University of Texas at Arlington. Organizers expected about 75,000 spectators, a crowd they figured could grow with World Cup fans in town after Friday's Egypt-Australia match at AT&T Stadium in Arlington. New this year was a 9 a.m. "ring out," with church bells and handbells across downtown pealing for America's 250th, an idea borrowed from the Daughters of the American Revolution. Friend, When our public officials make decisions, we should feel confident that the decisions they make will benefit the public – _not their investment portfolio._ **That’s why I introduced a bill to make sure that happens.** | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134640849/631796474/146200619?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MGFhODY2OC03MTc4LWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2ExNGI2ZDYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XgUtovD_J7DkUMH_eWEAO3df9_sL91NF_wtdXEFJPzo=&emci=f1e46238-3776-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&emdi=70aa8668-7178-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ceid=27257697)
**Bill would ban Insider Trading by public officials**
“A new bill would ban politicians, Supreme Court Justices, and other federal officials from trading stocks and using prediction markets to wager on government and politics.”
---
This bill would block public officials from owning and trading stocks and ban them from participating in certain prediction market contracts.
Instead of working to get things done, Washington insiders are busy getting rich off their inside knowledge – all while the people they’ve promised to serve are being left behind. It isn’t right or fair. Public service is a privilege – not a paycheck.
Friend, when I was elected to Congress, I set out to fight for mid-Michiganders – not line my own pockets. It's time Washington started putting the public interest ahead of personal profit and restored the trust the American people deserve to have in their government.

# Just The Truth
Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsor is Kirk Cameron and Brave Books, who are inviting supporters to help expand their faith-based children's series, _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ , and promote biblical values through family-friendly entertainment. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team
* * *
Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/Sv%2BWSyw6jR8c00E7JDzSEBUqGDSus%2B2uKW4dLuUQsjwfxVkZV6yfwooLyc8n%0Aq7PNIWr75ynsTsiRluAqDIhA0MeEWGVZWmapEseUHSW123EC6nxGi%2FATAulb%0ADQT7G55mOR1NcFHQw3KDJVEwOWVLF8PzM2o8jWlLQrDiai2xSyL255%2FjB6UM%0ALDC3zFYkwaGWeYI5H%2BSD0rMgSpvtMfFrNg%3D%3D%0A/6a3c56936815d51b)Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say......and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love.**[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/oZFEYUbgajBkLLeLehUE%2BQCy7qiFTfPsjAo830CWqeQ8OxDj%2F4AC7eiLm3EU%0A9WiIKPK308zyPcTV1AVRLAg50TEXzVCasnRvS%2BX5W9Kn5jddpli%2FUUQfssGW%0ALmnz6Lreg0B2BdUH1YL2%2FawvMNgMay1whQlagFhnVlgxvdI7kDlxa%2Bc%2BwMlU%0AvTf4Agmjxm0e3Io%2Bt0fAv1AvEN%2F5ypHTGw%3D%3D%0A/218f6b291a11aa04)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries.Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back!Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens.>> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with._**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_ You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn.The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately._**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_ I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio.And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture.**[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/QZmYmdVKLFMJb62oCdsd7EMlHGjDLw5v%2F16mc7H65jr2PQagsVYp0ry1Cm2u%0ASj4XzgMIToIgVUtK1oU6Dxfczo6xXUHB9hZy1CsLCHTOI7kdKkFUWZlgGu1o%0AE6QtUsJHbyy1IXR16V2DxZDlZaYnuHMGB62fdcYpG2FZdNvVPKSis9tD1VfZ%0AK5GwZtd%2Bthy%2FB5I5iwnpZrh9GPMXE%2BpzBA%3D%3D%0A/da3fe7a3795c5b64)** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. Obama's Presidential Center is very different from other modern Presidential Centers. Seated on more than 19 acres of formerly public land, it contains a variety of facilities, such as gardens and a sports center, that are designed to draw the community in. The Obama Foundation has **[advertised](https://substack.com/redirect/be437d86-e3cf-4963-905c-af055b4504a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that they want the center to be a place "that is more than a campus", using it to equip "people with the tools they need to shape their communities and elevating emerging leaders across borders." Although their vague goals of turning "hope into action" might sound innocent, their choice of facilities indicate that it operates like an Obama-led boot camp.

# [BREAKING ALER](https://substack.com/redirect/66c7bdf5-1f4c-4981-b885-759c7b3e23c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)T
#### How did they keep this quiet for so long!?
Nancy and Hillary have been **[CAUGHT IN THE ACT](https://substack.com/redirect/66c7bdf5-1f4c-4981-b885-759c7b3e23c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
Their secret partnership has just been exposed...
And the undeniable proof is **[inside this video](https://substack.com/redirect/66c7bdf5-1f4c-4981-b885-759c7b3e23c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
[Watch it HERE now](https://substack.com/redirect/66c7bdf5-1f4c-4981-b885-759c7b3e23c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
The proof? The Obama Center doesn't operate within the federal Presidential libraries system, controlled by the National Archives and Records Administration. It operates under the privately owned Obama Foundation, whose **[primary donors](https://substack.com/redirect/6fa75084-f0e1-4e76-ac96-e842513701e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6fa75084-f0e1-4e76-ac96-e842513701e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)include staunch Democrats including Bill Gates and the Pritzker family. All of its archives are digital, with just a few artifacts being loaned to the Center for display purposes, meaning that the Foundation has a tight grip on how information is presented. The Center _does_ have a reading room, designed in coordination with the Chicago Public Library, which was curated by Michelle and Barack. It contains several books from their personal collection, along with biographies of civil rights activists like Muhammed Ali and Martin Luther King Jr, and Che Guevera, the Marxist revolutionary from Cuba.
* * *
* * *
## The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you!
[Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/505524bc-aa1c-4d3f-9d80-228238cf49d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
What the Center lacks in historic documents, it makes up for in activist training facilities. At the heart of Obama's Center is the "Democracy in Action Lab", which is a space used for training young people. Greg Abbott is using a classic political sleight of hand.
He wants us trapped in endless, exhausting culture wars so that we don't notice the _real_ crisis in our state. He wants us looking the wrong way because he knows our public schools are severely underfunded, healthcare is out of reach, and everyday Texans can no longer afford the basics.
Abbott intentionally tears us apart because he fears what happens if we unite. He knows that if we stand together, we can dismantle corporate power and return opportunity to the people of Texas.

That is the choice we face this November.
We’re not going to be bullied into silence or inaction while he cashes in. We are officially done paying his corruption tax.
This is going to be a tough, high-stakes race, and the only way we win is by building a powerhouse grassroots coalition that refuses to back down.

Fellow American - Let me tell you something they don't teach you in Washington.

**I grew up in the back of a bar.**
Not a fancy restaurant. Not a supper club. A beer joint, pool hall, and liquor store on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - the Sanitary Cafe. My parents ran it. We lived behind it. I swept the floors, wiped down the tables, and fell asleep listening to the sounds of working people winding down after a long shift at the textile mill.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=82f92447f66b43d6a1987a9ead8872ce&_e=jKNTIho5CzIgAeo3_82GMZbVsT5XLh_tM6gj_noT2Ef-i9WcG3R8ZktSULYn4ghuVvJB3tMXrd9-9b0419ydP3U8Iwu_lEWhkxT4wPCMMqoUfjgLzZNgXJlYAjb9rmpAiAi_GTAjaXzPYgbmITEAUxPXkg58I1ooaH8AEcR-UPqGM-krc0EJNMihwj4WixRiImE9ZRSgWHqJUV7TM7iVSNmTME99eUgW31EPmjVSnCLeXUlKTbRrpdCLU48j42eITOVLZaq5jWtPYzEIiB1HufDcuZcChSHYCXGkKYY1p3vzcjGkXWOf4DUIDA6eeqp-dw1PB_CAAMgwqQqbwnmtSiThSQQWKp22IIc77Y1-7MNn15QWvyvx8KGBMAAWRFpMOQZyw1DMCWM7lpsSdurU2BG5FOi1QQR2SlUxPml0TBUZbUdfuEeYmaQxSGDxpimWKexRY8Fy4XV9hqRCQYqfVp3pZBfnyNIW71wQUOajdHx9D0xehW2ZnHXVMJBbHQcR9yUi2vWW0qe7IUaihO-jCDz6tsHpbvDCCsxQ23jdntBDDyLJQIv54gOY9MtwfNr8etBw_veJgUKX6g_-ZgA46MPdvlasb-MilwvsMD-kMu8NDL0ZgI5ApzanaFWmbL1_dO6gjWr1PuNFKe7dhO2eqS4b54n4qk1So1Ct77YxUXrewhVyuxq5jdkmTmzG8EBUaqYlYIN9p5ZerU1k8szX6i7TjeYiSHkIfFEttvX_hnIeH7TOgVELMQ9vT2t0NKmnj9JxTeO6AbNRpTOxjlVNkYQ_NnU_QiJyozuPLeFmp6PnqASyDMac27ZGQEXe8lSC)
Neither of my parents finished high school. But they worked as if the sun were always going down, and they believed - truly believed - that their kids would go further than they did.

I was the first in my family to go to college. And while I was there, I lost them both. Mom and Dad, died within two years of each other. I came home on weekends to keep the business going and helped raise my little sister, Darline, who was just 13.

I didn't have a safety net. I had no choice but to climb.

_**That's the South Carolina way. That's the American way.**_

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=82f92447f66b43d6a1987a9ead8872ce&_e=jKNTIho5CzIgAeo3_82GMZbVsT5XLh_tM6gj_noT2Ef-i9WcG3R8ZktSULYn4ghuVvJB3tMXrd9-9b0419ydP3U8Iwu_lEWhkxT4wPCMMqoUfjgLzZNgXJlYAjb9rmpAiAi_GTAjaXzPYgbmITEAUxPXkg58I1ooaH8AEcR-UPqGM-krc0EJNMihwj4WixRiImE9ZRSgWHqJUV7TM7iVSNmTME99eUgW31EPmjVSnCLeXUlKTbRrpdCLU48j42eITOVLZaq5jWtPYzEIiB1HufDcuZcChSHYCXGkKYY1p3tZCvPoXSaOG_fjwt9NbR6LnyDogm8zZNfKQxIuDH_GipEDbQn2W5vYeZwcBfQla7rRsB8ZyVGiFFcNrv-v76hE6AEjlH4BUVspAbyp7it8sn2e7QTNSpFN8lajQ0DgFX5zzyZRJLckFPMJddDj41x6k9U1iduAKKSHDR3dzDmmOHrygLB74k4XuWC-OSi_ZUZLSLhv1bl35Omm3EY6VDqrlpPCZ-GFgXW7T52Nl33aHHC1om4hTPS4XCaNhSw1K2P4YAwSL-yzaU6ZWFwooc1lxiBeg2yh5uBIItJZ00MyzA2FTQPzvvucpgV1xTJnKTDqmapb04FlQeR4Za34X8eiC67V228OqkT0I-o-ppzKdaAjSWwYzwQOwRrzFoBYllYE7H0bDrhjTT5hZHSY-pj_wN3Bvtld4Sv5cgRze9jKEAiqMI_MPg1R5ll0VpHkGpl4rt_NQ17BXHQHWVfyv0Mt-LAhs4cbboVlcKvtDWuq2zOH8fY1g7BBPsbKV0a8dhZPo1p1FC7gXyYQBuff4E6R)
After law school, I put on the uniform. I became a U.S. Air Force Judge Advocate - military prosecutor, defense attorney. Even after South Carolinians sent me to the Senate, I kept serving in the Reserves. I've been to Afghanistan. I've been to Iraq. I've stood next to kids from small towns just like Central who signed up because they believe in something bigger than themselves.

That's why I fight so hard, because I know exactly what's at stake.

The people coming to our family's pool hall after a long week - they weren't asking for much. Safe streets. A fair shot. A chance to build something. Those are the same things Americans want today.

And the folks on the other side of the aisle? They're perfectly happy to hand your neighborhood over to open borders, pile new taxes on your paycheck, and tell you to be grateful for it.

I won't stand for it. _Not for a second._

clean_body: I fight so hard because I know what's at stake. | Fellow American - Let me tell you something they don't teach you in Washington. I grew up in the back of a bar. Not a fancy restaurant. Not a supper club. A beer joint, pool hall, and liquor store on Main Street in Central, South Carolina - the Sanitary Cafe. My parents ran it. We lived behind it. I swept the floors, wiped down the tables, and fell asleep listening to the sounds of working people winding down after a long shift at the textile mill. Neither of my parents finished high school. But they worked as if the sun were always going down, and they believed - truly believed - that their kids would go further than they did. I was the first in my family to go to college. And while I was there, I lost them both. Mom and Dad, died within two years of each other. I came home on weekends to keep the business going and helped raise my little sister, Darline, who was just 13. I didn't have a safety net. I had no choice but to climb. That's the South Carolina way. That's the American way. After law school, I put on the uniform. I became a U.S. Air Force Judge Advocate - military prosecutor, defense attorney. Even after South Carolinians sent me to the Senate, I kept serving in the Reserves. I've been to Afghanistan. I've been to Iraq. I've stood next to kids from small towns just like Central who signed up because they believe in something bigger than themselves. That's why I fight so hard, because I know exactly what's at stake. The people coming to our family's pool hall after a long week - they weren't asking for much. Safe streets. A fair shot. A chance to build something. Those are the same things Americans want today. And the folks on the other side of the aisle? They're perfectly happy to hand your neighborhood over to open borders, pile new taxes on your paycheck, and tell you to be grateful for it. I won't stand for it. Not for a second. We are in a fight for the future of this country, and it is not a time to sit on the sidelines. I didn't come from money. I came from a bar in South Carolina, a mother who worked hard, and a faith that hard work still means something in America. It still does. Thank you for standing with me. God bless you, and God bless South Carolina. Dear Peter,
I'm proud to endorse Aisha Farooqi for Congress in Michigan's 11th District.
Aisha is the daughter of immigrants, a former legal aid attorney and prosecutor, and a lifelong fighter for working people. She has spent her career standing up for families who were ignored, taking on tough fights, and making sure justice wasn't reserved for those with power or wealth.
That's why I'm supporting her.
Aisha and I are both proud to be endorsed by Track AIPAC because we believe Democrats should answer to voters—not powerful special interests. We refuse to take AIPAC money, and we won't back down from fighting for peace, human rights, and an independent foreign policy.
Aisha has been unequivocal in calling for an end to the genocide in Gaza. She won't cave when it's politically inconvenient. She'll lead.
She'll also fight for affordable health care, lower costs, workers' rights, and an economy that works for working people—not just billionaires.
Congress needs more leaders with courage. People who can't be bought. People willing to challenge both Donald Trump and the special interests that have too much influence in Washington.
Aisha is one of those leaders.
Will you split a contribution today between my campaign and Aisha's campaign to help elect another champion for working people, peace, and accountability? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rk_aisha_endorsement?refcode=20260705]

The future of our party depends on electing leaders with the courage to stand on principle—even when it's difficult.
I hope you'll join me in supporting Aisha today.
In solidarity,
Ro

body:
Waking up to this every day is absolutely infuriating.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260705-1&t=1&akid=3677%2E587540%2Etzgp6P)
Peter,
**Waking up every day to watch this administration dismantle our democracy piece by piece is absolutely infuriating.**
And honestly, we don’t have the luxury of playing nice and waiting around for the rest of the Democratic Party to wake the hell up. Not when the fights we’re up against are this dire.
Trump is waging an illegal war in Iran that has already cost Americans an estimated $30 billion and counting. Gas is getting higher by the minute, grocery bills keep climbing, and millions of people can’t afford to go to the doctor. Working families are being left to survive a corrupt political system that continues to put the wealthy and powerful first.
This is the moment to go all in. We have to fight back on every front, with every tool at our disposal, and do more than just react. **We have to build.**
That means organizing against the most vulnerable Republicans and making it clear that there is a real political price to pay for enabling Trump’s dangerous agenda.
It means primarying asleep-at-the-wheel Democrats — because if they’re not fighting with us, they’re in the way.
And it means we have to turn the fracturing of Trump’s base into an opportunity — because young voters are souring on him, they’re feeling betrayed, and the window to offer them a vision worth believing in is _right now._
Most importantly, we need to throw all of our support behind the leaders who feel the urgency of this moment in their bones and a fire in their belly to take on the broken system they grew up in, and change it.
**That’s what Leaders We Deserve was built for.** Not to be just another political organization throwing endorsements around. But to actually get in the arena — to find the fearless candidates who refuse to sit on the sidelines while their communities get left behind, put real resources behind their campaigns, and prove that the establishment doesn’t get to decide what the face of power in this Party looks like anymore.
And right now, we need you in this fight with us.
**[Can you pitch in $5 today to power our work?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260705_1_infuriating.c4hCxi&refcode=em20260705-3677&amount=5&t=2&akid=3677%2E587540%2Etzgp6P)**

Thank you for being part of this movement,
David Hogg

With only 75 days until early voting in Virginia kicks off, this campaign is entering a critical stretch. That’s why I’m reaching out today for something deeply important – and no, it’s not a donation to my campaign. I’m asking for something I value even more: **your input**.

Folks are struggling with the rising cost of living, concerned with our president’s reckless foreign policy driving up the cost of gasoline, and grappling with shrinking access to health care that is gutting rural hospitals and skyrocketing insurance costs.

**Those conversations remind me of why I’m in this fight. They directly inform my work in Washington – and they inform what this campaign is fighting for.**

Now, I couldn’t possibly get the chance to talk with _every_ Virginian before election day (as much as I would like to), so surveys like this one are one of the best ways for my campaign to hear from folks like you.

The feedback we get from you will directly inform the decisions my campaign makes over the final few months ahead before voters head to the polls. Where we spend our resources, the issues we emphasize, and the kind of operation we build in this final homestretch.

subject: [Add your name] Demand a real pathway to citizenship for Dreamers

body:
14 years of DACA, and there still isn’t a real pathway to citizenship.
#
Peter,
**Last month marked the 14th anniversary of the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program.**
Because of this program, _**nearly half a million Dreamers**_ have been woven into the fabric of our communities, working as our teachers, healthcare workers, entrepreneurs, and neighbors.
Yet right now, their futures are still under direct, terrifying assault.
Since the start of 2025, Dreamers have increasingly found themselves caught in the crosshairs of aggressive immigration enforcement, with hundreds detained and dozens deported. No one should have to wake up wondering if they will be torn away from the only home they have ever known.
We can’t allow the Trump administration or a GOP-controlled Congress to treat our loved ones and neighbors as political bargaining chips. We need to send an undeniable message that our community will hold every single elected official accountable.

This race is going to be tough. National Republicans and John Sununu are

We beat her once and with your help, we’ll do it again.

name: Wes Moore
subject: What patriotism actually means.
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1583%2E1086043%2Ep_66CA)
Peter, I want to talk about what patriotism actually means.
I grew up in a family that loved this country even when the country didn't always love them back. That shaped _everything_ I believe.
Patriotism is not waving a flag around. It's not a boast. It's not telling your neighbors you're better than them.
**_You cannot love your country if you hate half of the people in it._**
Real patriotism means lifting each other up. Improving each other's lives. Knowing this country is great -- and working together to make it even greater, because more people will benefit from that.

name: Katie Britt (R-AL)
subject: Back home, we did things a little differently.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc
body:
Everything I am started in Alabama.
|
---
| | | | [](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
---
| | |
---
| | Friend,
My name is Katie Britt, and if it’s alright with you, I’d like to share a little about who I am. **I’m not part of the D.C. cocktail circuit, and I never will be._That’s just not who I am._**

In 2022, I was elected to represent the great state of Alabama in the United States Senate. I became the first woman in Alabama’s history to hold this seat—but that’s not why I ran.

I ran because I’m a _**mom**_ , a _**wife**_ , and a _**conservative**_ who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system.

I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down.
---
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Before coming to the Senate, I served as the first female president and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama, and before that, I was Chief of Staff to Senator Richard Shelby. **I’ve never shied away from a challenge—and I’ve never forgotten who I’m fighting for.** In every role I’ve held, my mission has been the same: _deliver real results for Alabama families and the American people._
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Before starting my career in public service, I earned my undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Alabama. That experience taught me how to lead, think on my feet, and fight for what I believe in—**and it laid the foundation for _everything_ I’ve done since.**
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
But long before that, I was just a small-town girl from Enterprise, Alabama. My dad ran the local hardware store. My mom taught dance to almost every kid in town. We didn’t grow up with wealth or political connections. **We came from hard work, grit, and doing things the right way._That’s how I was raised, and that’s exactly how I lead._**
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
My husband Wesley and our two amazing kids are my rock. In 2011, a tornado tore through our home and nearly took our lives. That moment changed everything, and reminded me what truly matters. __**Faith** , **family** , and **resilience**.__
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
[](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
I’ve lived a life full of hard work, determination, and breaking barriers. There have been challenges and triumphs alike, but I wouldn’t trade any of it.

My story is a testament to what America stands for—the American Dream. From a small town in Alabama, I rose to become my state’s U.S. Senator—a woman who’s breaking barriers and fighting for conservative values every day.

_**_I’m living proof of the limitless opportunity and freedom that define this country._**_

But, I didn’t get here by playing it safe or staying quiet, **and I’m not about to start now.**

The radical Left wants to _silence_ conservatives like me. They want to drown out our voices and push their agenda without opposition, but I’m standing firm.

I’m fighting tooth and nail to keep up and push back hard, for Alabama, for our values, and for every American who believes in freedom.

**The support I’ve received so far means everything, but this fight is far from over.** We need the resources to keep going strong and hold our ground.

**[So, after hearing a bit of my story, will you take a moment to chip in whatever you can afford to help me keep up this fight? The road ahead won’t be easy, but I’ve faced tough battles before. And it would mean the world to have you standing with me.](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)**
|
---
[CHIP IN TO FIGHT WITH KATIE BRITT >>](https://link.email.brittforsenate.)
|
---
Thank you, and may God bless America.

Katie Britt (R-AL)

I ran because I’m a mom , a wife , and a conservative who’s fed up with the direction this country is heading. I came to Washington to fight for our families, to protect our values, and to bring some Alabama backbone to a broken system. I didn’t come here to make friends with the political elite. I came here to stand up for the people who don’t have a voice in the room—and I’m not backing down. | | Before coming to the Senate, I served as the first female president and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama, and before that, I was Chief of Staff to Senator Richard Shelby. I’ve never shied away from a challenge—and I’ve never forgotten who I’m fighting for. In every role I’ve held, my mission has been the same: deliver real results for Alabama families and the American people. | | Before starting my career in public service, I earned my undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Alabama. That experience taught me how to lead, think on my feet, and fight for what I believe in—and it laid the foundation for everything I’ve done since. | | | | But long before that, I was just a small-town girl from Enterprise, Alabama. My dad ran the local hardware store. My mom taught dance to almost every kid in town. We didn’t grow up with wealth or political connections. We came from hard work, grit, and doing things the right way.That’s how I was raised, and that’s exactly how I lead. | | My husband Wesley and our two amazing kids are my rock. In 2011, a tornado tore through our home and nearly took our lives. That moment changed everything, and reminded me what truly matters. Faith , family , and resilience. | | | | I’ve lived a life full of hard work, determination, and breaking barriers. There have been challenges and triumphs alike, but I wouldn’t trade any of it. My story is a testament to what America stands for—the American Dream. From a small town in Alabama, I rose to become my state’s U.S. Senator—a woman who’s breaking barriers and fighting for conservative values every day. I’m living proof of the limitless opportunity and freedom that define this country. But, I didn’t get here by playing it safe or staying quiet, and I’m not about to start now. The radical Left wants to silence conservatives like me. They want to drown out our voices and push their agenda without opposition, but I’m standing firm. I’m fighting tooth and nail to keep up and push back hard, for Alabama, for our values, and for every American who believes in freedom. The support I’ve received so far means everything, but this fight is far from over. We need the resources to keep going strong and hold our ground. | | Thank you, and may God bless America. Katie Britt (R-AL) | | | | | ** | | | | | We'd be sad to see you go, but if you want to stop receiving our emails, click** | | Paid for by Britt for Alabama, Inc.

subject: Every fundraising team knows about this →

body:
The work doesn’t slow down, even if the donations do |
#
---
Team, Can we pull back the curtain for a minute? Every fundraising team knows about the _"summer slump."_ Once the Fourth of July rolls around, people spend more time with family, take vacations, and are away from their computers enjoying the warmer weather. Grassroots donations naturally slow down — and truly, we don't blame anyone for that. name: Tom Perriello
subject: Why I'm celebrating America's 250th
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TOM PERRIELLO FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50]
Folks,
I hope you had a wonderful Independence Day!
I genuinely love the Fourth of July. I love fireworks and flags. I love the cookouts and quality time with family. Most of all, I love celebrating the endurance of America's promise that every human has an inalienable right to life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness.
For all of their many flaws, the signers of the Declaration of Independence got a few things absolutely and audaciously right – that we are all created equal, that government draws its legitimacy from the consent of the governed, and that all people have inalienable rights, and that among these are life. Liberty and the pursuit of happiness.
These three foundations are so strong that Americans wrongfully excluded from its promises have chosen to demand their rightful and equal entry into the house, rather than tear down these pillars.
I even love that we start the clock at the signing of the Declaration of Independence, even though we had not won anything yet – not Yorktown or the Treaty of Paris. Because America is unique as a nation born at the moment of aspiration.
You may think that things are too bleak to celebrate, so I made you a July 4th present – a video essay full of local history that gives us reasons to celebrate this 250th. Across a district first represented by the author of the Constitution, I travelled through Appomattox and Bedford and more to highlight how even making it to 250 is a miracle, and how different generations of Americans have pushed us closer to our aspirations.
That's the inspiration behind a new video series we launched, beginning with Episode One.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wH6ueQA_fJ8&t=1 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wH6ueQA_fJ8&t=1]
If you enjoy it, I'd be grateful if you'd share it with friends and family or post it on social media. We've also created a page on our website where you can follow the entire "America at 250" series. You can view the full series here. [https://www.tomperriello.com/freedom-in-the-5th]
The Declaration closes with these words:
"We mutually pledge to each other our Lives, our Fortunes, and our sacred Honor."
Whenever America has faced its greatest challenges, ordinary people have answered that call. I believe, with every fiber of my being, that our generation is capable of doing the same.
Thank you for taking the time to watch, and I hope you enjoy the series!

Peter, it’s Aly. I just wanted to say: _Thank you, thank you, thank you._ We reached out a few days ago ahead of our biggest fundraising deadline yet, and the final numbers in our report tell a story I’m so proud of: **We’ve raised more than $365,000 from over 1,200 donations — more than 80% of which came from right here in Vermont.** Importantly, not a single dollar came from a corporation or a corporate PAC, and not a single dollar raised by my campaign ever will! Peter,
Advance Colorado just quietly withdrew one of their gerrymandering measures. They're hoping nobody notices the one they didn't.
Initiative #251 would have added a simple ban: no map "drawn purposefully to favor one political party." It's gone now, pulled from circulation.
But Initiative #256 is still out there, and it's worse. Instead of adding language, it repeals and reenacts Colorado's entire congressional redistricting structure from scratch, burying that same ban on maps drawn to favor one party inside a total rewrite. Advance Colorado is going to tell you this is a routine reenactment with no major changes. Don't believe it. The whole point is to hide the one protection that stops us from fighting back against Trump's plan to steal our democracy, tucked in where they're betting nobody will look.
Can't fool us.
#256 isn't some long shot. As of June 29, it's already collected 75% of the signatures needed to make the ballot.
They're not stopping there. Initiative #362 would impose new mail-ballot voter ID requirements. Advance Colorado's notorious President Michael Field, formerly of the Kochs' dark money network, kept his name off of this one. He filed it through Advance Colorado's attorney instead. Same dark money operation, just one step removed so it's harder to trace back to them.
This is the pattern. Bury the bad part. Take your name off the paperwork. Hope voters don't dig far enough to find you.
Can't fool us. We're not letting either of these sail through on autopilot.

clean_body: | = Friend, This week, the Supreme Court delivered a major rebuke to Donald Trump's attempt to end birthright citizenship. When the decision came down, I felt a massive sense of relief. But as I read the details, alarm bells started ringing: This 6-3 decision was disturbingly close. We came within just a few votes of watching a fundamental constitutional right completely vanish. Trump’s cruel attacks on our democracy have failed again – but we cannot assume this fight is over. Because America welcomed my refugee parents, I was given the opportunity to enlist in the U.S. Army, start a small business, and now, serve as your voice in Congress. That is the American Dream. And it only exists because of the 14th Amendment's promise: If you are born here, you have a constitutional right to U.S. citizenship. | Birthright citizenship isn't a political talking point – it's a constitutional guarantee that affects millions of families like mine. I'll always keep fighting in Congress to protect immigrant families and defend the American Dream. name: Mallory McMorrow
subject: Suspending this campaign, not leaving the fight
body:
[ https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/83?t=1001&akid=5076%2E898137%2ErqJvh- ][IMG]

Hi

Today, I'm announcing that I am suspending my campaign for United States
Senate.

And I'm doing it with a deep, deep sense of gratitude. For our thousands
of volunteers across the great state of Michigan — so many of you who told
me this campaign was what inspired you to get involved for the very first
time. For the over 150,000 of you who donated from all 83 counties and all
fifty states — five dollars, ten dollars, whatever you could — building a
campaign with zero corporate PAC dollars, because you believed we could be
more powerful than a broken system where the wealthiest have the most say.
For my staff, who built this team up from nothing — who took a real risk
on a scrappy state Senator who had never run for federal or statewide
office before, going up against two people who had. I thank you.

And for my family, who didn't ask for any of this, but who went in eyes
wide open and with more love than I could have ever imagined. My siblings,
who had to read about their sister all over the internet. My mom, who
never missed a single TV interview. My dad, who drove up for every
fundraiser and canvass he could make. My husband Ray, who believed in me
long before I ever believed in myself, who has sacrificed more for this
journey than I could ever share, and who never — ever — let go of that
belief. I thank you.

But there’s one more person I have to thank.

Every morning, when I leave for work, my five-year-old daughter Noa runs
to the front window to wave goodbye.

Some mornings I'm already out the door — late, arms full, head full of the
day — and I turn around, and there she is. Still in her jammies. Barefoot
on the driveway. Just to give me one more hug before I go.

And every time, it reminds me of the only thing that actually matters:
everything I do, I do for her.

Recently, on the way to another campaign event, Noa said to me: "Remember,
Mom — it's not about if you win. It's about trying hard and having fun."

She's right. So I want to be very clear about what this announcement is
not. While I may be suspending this campaign, I am not leaving this fight.

I never planned on politics. The night of the 2016 election, I lay in bed
feeling what a lot of you felt — like the country I thought I lived in had
become a place I didn't recognize. And I had a choice: stay heartbroken,
or do something. So I picked up my phone and typed five words into a
search bar: "How to run for office."

That's where this started. No machine. No big donors. No one in a back
room deciding it was my turn. Just a woman who decided being angry wasn't
enough.

And here's what I learned: when regular people get in the fight, they make
a difference. In my very first election, we beat an entrenched Republican
incumbent — in a district he'd carried by sixteen points.

Then, four years later, we flipped the Michigan Senate for the first time
in nearly forty years. And we didn't stop at winning. We repealed
Michigan's abortion ban. We raised the minimum wage. We expanded civil
rights, voting rights. We made sure every child in Michigan gets breakfast
and lunch at school.

And as gun violence became the number one killer of our kids, we took on
the NRA – and even opposition in our own party – and we passed the
strongest gun safety laws in our state's history.

None of that happened because of one election, one bill, or one person. It
took legislators who did the work years before there was a path. It took
thousands of organizers and volunteers who showed up even when it was
nerve-wracking. Every issue — no matter how big or how small — takes all
of us. Every single day. And a refusal to give up when there are setbacks.

That's why I'm staying in this fight. And it's why I need you to stay in
it with me.

Because everywhere I've been this past year — breweries, union halls,
living rooms — from Macomb to Manistee — people tell me versions of the
same story: "I did everything right, and I'm still getting screwed." And
here's the truth too many in my own party won’t say: Donald Trump didn't
start this. This was decades in the making — decisions by both parties
that left people so far behind, a lot of them decided they'd rather blow
the system up than trust it one more time.

So no — I'm not interested in putting the pieces back where they were. The
way things were wasn't working for any of us. We need to build something
new — something that finally works for everyone.

I haven’t been shy about calling for new leadership and a better
Democratic party. I mean it. The energy is there. People are crying out
for change. We owe it to them to listen.

But today, I want to talk about what we're fighting for. Because it's not
enough to say what we're fighting against — and we can't ask people to
fight for a future they can't see.

So here’s the future that I see. It’s a Michigan where a kid growing up in
any corner of this state has the same shot as a kid growing up anywhere on
earth. Where childhood belongs to children again — where a kid gets to be
10 years old, curious and free, instead of a product sold to the highest
bidder by companies that built machines and apps to capture their
attention and never give it back. I see kids who grow up unafraid — who
never have to watch their friends gunned down in school, or watch someone
they love dragged away by masked agents. And I see a kid born in this
state who can actually afford to build a life here — a home, a family, a
future that doesn't require leaving the place that raised them.

Every generation throughout this country's history has given their kids
more than they were given. We're the first being told to expect less — to
dream smaller. I’ve never accepted that. And I'm not about to start now.

So here's what I'll be doing — and what I hope you'll do with me — every
day from now until November 3rd.

I’ll be fighting to hold this Senate seat and send Mike Rogers back to
Florida for good. That means whoever wins this primary on August 4th will
have my full support — and I'm asking you to join me in making that same
pledge.

But we won’t stop there. We’ll elect Jocelyn Benson as our next Governor.
We’ll flip the state House, and we’ll expand our majority in the state
Senate. We will elect Democrats up and down the ticket and show the rest
of this country what it means to fight like Michigan.

Ten years ago, I started this work heartbroken, typing five words into a
search bar. And I learned the only thing that has ever really changed this
country: ordinary people who love something enough to fight for it —
refusing to wait for permission, and refusing to be deterred when one door
closes, because so many others are open, waiting for you to walk through
them.

Today, at the 250th birthday of a country founded on the radical idea that
all men — and women — are created equal, that we are endowed with certain
unalienable rights, that among these are Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of
Happiness — let's recommit ourselves to this fight.

I love this country. I love Michigan. And I love a little girl who waves
at me from the window every morning, trusting the grown-ups to leave her a
state and a country worth inheriting.

That's who I'm fighting for.

And I'm not going anywhere. I hope you'll join me.

—Mallory

Pero este trabajo no se logra sin ustedes. ¿ Podrias aportar hoy para ayudarnos a seguir ofreciendo resultados reales y significativos para las familias de Rhode Island? ~ ~ ~ P.D. Ya sea que puedas aportar $2.50, $250 o cualquier cantidad intermedia , cada d olar mantiene vivo este impulso. ¡ Brindamos por otros 250 años! ⭐ | ¡ Enfrentando la codicia corporativa - y ganando! | ~ La codicia corporativa ha aumentado el precio de los alimentos y ha creado desiertos alimentarios en nuestro estado. Es por eso que presente un proyecto de ley para dar la pelea, prohibiendo las t acticas que las corporaciones usan para impedir la apertura de nuevos supermercados. Llevamos a cabo un evento en Woonsocket para celebrar la firma de esta medida, que ahora es ley estatal en Rhode Island. Me uni al sindicato de Trabajadores de la Alimentacion y del Comercio (UFCW) para celebrar otra victoria contra la codicia corporativa, luego de que el Gobernador firmara una legislacion paraproteger a los consumidores y trabajadores, evitando que los grandes supermercados reemplacen a todos sus cajeros por sistemas de auto-pago. ¡La UFCW ha respaldado mi campaña! | ¡ Los respaldos siguen llegando! ¡Los Comit es Democratas de las ciudades de Providence y East Providence acaban de respaldar mi campaña! name: Chloe Cole
subject: The case against Kaiser begins with a lie told to a 12-year-old's parents.
body:
My name is Chloe Cole. Before I tell you my story, I want to read you the lies. One by one.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7147894/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3Yvc3JxRmFzdkFBSw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA3MDU/LbmNsN3laU3I2Zw/qP2hpZHM9bmN6MUJ0bFdkaTV5dlBscw/gakqwBA/s2me13da0ba)
| | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | | Patriot, Before I tell you my story, I want to read you the lies. Not my opinion about what happened to me. Not my interpretation. **The specific, verifiable, documented lies that were told — to my parents, to me, and to the public — by the doctors and institutions that built a medical industry out of treating children like me.** I know these lies intimately. Not because I read about them in a study. Not because someone told me they existed. **Because every single one of them was told to me.**
---
[ **Deliver the Verdict** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
My name is Chloe Cole. I am a detransitioner. I am 21 years old. And on April 5, 2027, I am taking Kaiser Foundation Hospitals to trial. Here is the case. **LIE #1:****_"Your child will attempt suicide without immediate medical intervention."_** I was 12 years old when a gender specialist looked at my parents and said that if they didn't put me on a medical path, I would be at risk of suicide. I was not suicidal. I was a confused girl who had started puberty early, didn't fit in with the girls in her class, and didn't know why she felt so out of place. I was struggling. I was not in crisis. The suicide threat was the mechanism. It was the tool used to override my parents' hesitation, override the time they needed to think, override every instinct that told them to slow down. **It was a lie told to frightened parents by a credentialed professional in a clinical setting.** And it worked. **LIE #2:****_"This treatment is reversible. You can always stop."_** At 13, I began testosterone injections. I will likely have medical complications for the rest of my life. The body that was mine before I was old enough to understand what I was doing is now gone. My fertility is still unknown. **There was no reversibility. There never was.** The word "reversible" was used to deceive and hide the truth about an irreversible medical intervention on a child. That is not medicine. That is a lie with a syringe behind it. **LIE #3:****_"Surgery is the appropriate next step for a patient at this stage."_** At 15, a surgeon at a Kaiser Foundation Hospital facility removed my breasts. I was a child. I didn't understand what breastfeeding was. I didn't understand what that part of my future meant. I didn't understand what nerve damage was, or that it was a documented and expected outcome of the procedure. No one at that facility stopped to ask whether I might change my mind. No one slowed down. It was just assumed that I was actually a boy born in the “wrong body.” **The tissue removed in that operating room does not grow back. There is no reversal.** The skin grafts from my surgery failed two years later. I was 17. I still manage the complications today. The doctors who performed that surgery have not once reached out to help. **They called it appropriate care. I call it what it was.** **LIE #4:****_"Children who are affirmed have better mental health outcomes."_** At 16 — after the testosterone injections, after the surgery, after clinical language and the assurances — I became suicidal for the first time. The nightmare the doctors told my parents they were preventing? **They caused it.** I am not a statistic. I am a person. But I am also not alone. Detransitioners across this country describe the same sequence: the assurances, the interventions, the moment of realization, and then the crash that the clinics never prepared them for — and never took responsibility for. The studies the gender industry cites to support "affirmation" are now being retracted, revised, and challenged in courts and legislatures across the world. **The evidence was always weaker than the language was confident.** **LIE #5:****_"This was the patient's choice."_** A child cannot consent to a procedure she does not understand, after a process designed to ensure she would agree, following years of medical and social conditioning that made any other outcome feel like death. I was coerced. They put my parents under duress. Now what happened to me is a question for a jury. **On April 5, 2027, that jury will convene.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Patriot, I've given you the case. Five lies. Told to a child and her parents by credentialed professionals inside a licensed American hospital. Told in a language designed to sound like medicine. Documented in records that will be entered into evidence. On April 5, 2027, twelve Americans will sit in a California courtroom and hear all of it. They will hear what doctors did to me. What the doctors said. And what _real_ medical experts think about my doctors’ “treatment” of me. **They will deliver a verdict.** You are the reason that case is funded. You are the reason the lawyers are prepared. You are the reason the witnesses are ready. **You are the reason those twelve people get to hear the truth.**
---
[ **Deliver the Verdict** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
The lies have been read into the record. **Now it's time to deliver the verdict.**
---
Chloe Cole On behalf of the Center for American Liberty
---
---
**P.S.** April 5, 2027. My trial against Kaiser Foundation Hospitals. They tried everything to keep these lies out of a courtroom — arbitration, sealed records, delays. The courts said no. The first detransitioner malpractice jury already sided with a young woman just like me. Now I need to walk in on April 5 with the strongest team possible. Your $100 today goes straight into funding the fight. The lies are on record. Help me get them in front of a jury.
---

body:
I've seen Chris's work up close, and I know he'll bring the same seriousness and thoughtfulness to the Senate.

Folks, there’s no other way to put this: **_Democrats can’t win back the Senate without New Hampshire._**
We have a real opportunity right now to build a Senate majority that will fight for working families, protect our fundamental freedoms, and stand up to Donald Trump and his reckless administration.
**[The only path runs through NH. Will you donate $5 or whatever you can to help elect Chris Pappas?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260705_2.nvTFd2&refcode=em20260705-2&t=2&akid=7576%2E582294%2Eu-0m1Z)**

Chris Pappas is exactly the leader we need in the Senate. He’s spent his life fighting for Granite Staters and has worked to make the government accountable to the people it serves.
But national Republicans and their allies know the stakes of this race. That’s why they are already pouring millions into New Hampshire.
We cannot take our eye off the ball. New Hampshire is a purple state.
This race could come down to the slimmest of margins, and Chris needs grassroots support today — _not tomorrow, not next week_ — to build the campaign infrastructure to win.
**[That’s where you come in, folks. Chip in anything you can today to power Chris’s campaign and flip the Senate blue?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260705_2.nvTFd2&refcode=em20260705-2&t=22&akid=7576%2E582294%2Eu-0m1Z)**

# [Happy 250th Birthday America!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/07/05/happy-250th-birthday-america/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on July 5, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 07.05.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=bd4d045ad16a3aa5d1ebabd19cc025012965685e60a9d1ddd4cf9b92b5b7e406&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=90862d2fc80d5ef3b183efab43f0b90c&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)**
---
| **Happy 250th Birthday America!**
---
[https://www.facebook.com/reel/2576510592798406](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=179e67059ca8aadf078304d3292e125850c36db5555a3554c140592a657d4498&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=c0a19d584be4eecc4b1d2067499c7933&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL3JlZWwvMjU3NjUxMDU5Mjc5ODQwNg=&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)
Happy 250th Birthday America!
---
Many thanks to the Gettysburg Area Recreational Authority for hosting a lovely evening of fireworks and community.
---
Though there were a few interruptions from the weather, it was ultimately a very pleasant evening.
---
May we realize the ideals of our nation the Revolutionary Founders began and the marching generations improved because, “ALL...are created EQUAL.”
---
May we always [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=96e0a614b245b1a553bb8545c0009bcda82567612064699c3db7e9e7e7d3126b&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=0fc48c3eeb0e7272ff86f5ccd197837e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL3JlZWwvaGFzaHRhZy8/cT0lMjNDaG9vc2VEZW1vY3JhY3kmX190bl9fPUs&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) !
---
| **4th of July Parade in Landisburg**
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
Many, many thanks to the Landisburg Lions Club , the Ickesburg Lions Club, and the Loysville Community Center for sponsoring today’s 250th Anniversary of American Independence.
---
It was a beautiful morning to greet voters as we walked through beautiful downtown Landisburg. I appreciate the sense of community as bothe the Democratic and Republican floats were welcomed, as were church floats, agricultural floats, and many decorated tractors that made their way through this charming small town.
---
Special shout-outs to Diane Bowman-Shenk and Carney of the Perry County Democratic Committee for hosting my signs on their lovely float and fellow candidates Nathan Wood for State Senate and Wendy Morgan for State Representative.
---
May we always choose these norms of Democracy and [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=4e61ffef1cd8634a7b6e5b3c74ca9e734aabf826edab25b7c7cea274bde8df65&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=9cfcd72eb074cd11dce3e24d03ea4d90&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) itself.
---
| | **Posers Gonna Pose**
---
Our beloved country was founded on the principle of self-governance and America became a beacon of Democracy for the world.
---
One cannot simply pose at a desk in Independence Hall in Philadelphia then yield the power of The People to a wannabe king.
---
Our gleaming city on a hill came about because people in power swore an oath to the US Constitution, not a man.
---
One cannot pose under the dome of the US Capitol then remain silent about its desecration by Trump supporters on January 6th 2021.
---
The United States of America has been a leading example of the peaceful transfer of power.
---
One cannot celebrate the 4th of July and the Democracy that Revolutionary veterans bled for then refuse to certify our valid electoral votes for Biden under the false claim that Trump won.
---
The United States President lives in The People’s House, not in a golden castle.
---
One cannot pose with said wannabe king in a guilded Oval Office and pretend to represent The People.
---
The People know what an elitist poser multimillionaire John Joyce is.
---
The People will fire the fraudulent John Joyce on November 3rd by electing me, Beth Farnham, an Everyday American who will truly represent us.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=5605278b7924ffa9893e41a4d12fadc5bdf864491ba180cc949e1d6183ee27f3&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=45a8eb750f36785b7750149fad52adcd&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) and actually celebrate American Independence from the British monarchy!
---
| |
---|---
| **Pride in Hanover**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to Little Fox Books and Michael in Hanover for hosting their wonderful Pride event last Sunda. I met with many voters and discussed the issues near and dear to our hearts. Together we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=7af795a840ddfab9c353b391ca59dacadb5081639142b7346ee9077cf274fefc&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=792a147eae58ae579f0b61bdba608ded&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) !
---
Photo with Michael and his husband Thomas Johnson For PA Senate district 28
---
| **Promises Broken**
---
| |
---
While President Trump amassed over $1Billion from cryptocurrency, Everyday Americans have been burdened by more debt.
---
Why?
---
Because Trump never made anything better, he only is out there for himself, using the US Presidency to prey upon unsuspecting Americans for their investments in cryptocurrency and their lack of insider knowledge concerning his announcements.
---
Trump isn’t trying to “make America great,” he merely wants to enrich himself. That’s why he pushed the One Big Beautiful Bill Act – to give himself and his billionaire cronies tax breaks.
---
Meanwhile, our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, signed the One Big Beautiful Bill Act and doesn’t care if PA-13 residents lose Medicaid, SNAP, or experience hardship due to Trump’s incompetent war in Iran, Trump’s incompetent tariff policies by tweet, Trump’s illegal impoundment of congressionally-approved funds that he let Elon Musk seize, or increases in Pennie healthcare premiums.
---
The important thing is that John Joyce fully supports Trump’s agenda.
---
But I don’t support Trump’s agenda.
---
I recognize your suffering.
---
I believe that the ultra-wealthy should pay their fair share in taxes so that Everyday Americans can afford bread on their table, gas in their car, and their healthcare.
---
And Everyday Americans aren’t asking for too much, just Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd because when you choose Beth Farnham, you [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=b633353738625c1a0c73f581c4d1784947e070f438c7bf5d7064b53c66d9afbc&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=a678686a9266ede10cd53a18decfb41e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) and Affordability!
---
(image credits: Ramsey solutions and Forbes)
---
[Credit Card Defaults Hit Highest Level](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=457e91f0ad70fd3ce52c11f42b704bf2206a8fd9de53d5a6852cb13f4abf10fa&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=c4e0344ad43f0139efd3e1f8e944e5a6&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)
---
[Trump’s Financial Disclosures](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=dbcffa534cbf115cbff66207e9b8dc7b698f5df1d3d931541128017edddeb83c&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=ccf6be7b786361ad7578c07c8b175f9b&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)
---
| **Grand Opening of Campaign Headquarters!**
---
Many thanks to All Who Attended the Grand Opening of our Beth Farnham for Congress campaign headquarters on Wednesday!
---
Already, volunteers are signing up to volunteer with this campaign for Democracy in the most important election of our lives. Guests walked away with packets of postcards in order to get my messages of Democracy, Reproductive Freedom, Affordability, and more out to voters across our beautiful 13th Congressional District.
---
There is even a space to honor your loved ones who served this country with a place to put their picture.
---
Many thanks to Team Member Sue, Campaign Manager Jack, and Volunteer Joyce for helping to set up the event.
---
Special shout-outs to Sue for her FREEDOM cookies, to Sandy for her pink lemonade cookies, and to Laura Quick for coming down all the way from Lebanon County!
---
If you would like to volunteer with Beth Farnham for Congress, please sign up at this link: [https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/welcome-volunteers/](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=6d89fe11b8277e85451fc365e70b68d88b8c8a82c755b26bce022d47c193f45e&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=8ed2b71148a788b0eba7dff6c092c505&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9iZXRoZmFybmhhbWZvcmNvbmdyZXNzLmNvbS93ZWxjb21lLXZvbHVudGVlcnMv&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=ec26496fb2b9c5af052dd80d59212c73b95965f8b407224905f7886f35e6d281&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=cca63636cddd4d3e23d09f658c7b5562&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) !
---
| | |
---|---|---
| |
---|---|---
|
---|---
| |
---
| **Won’t Someone Please Think of the Oath breakers?**
---
| |
---
Birthright citizenship is a right enshrined in the Constitution’s 14th Amendment for everyone born on US soil.
---
When Trump issued his Executive Order in January 2025 to end it, he not only misconstrued the 14th Amendment, he broke his oath to “preserve, protect, and defend” the Constitution of the United States.
---
Of course, our own US Representative, multimillionaire John Joyce, who has repeatedly preached against undocumented immigrants, maligning them with false claims of voter fraud, does not stand for the 14th Amendment, especially concerning the US born children of those same immigrants. You won’t find any quote of his in support of today’s decision. He supports Trump’s twisted and unAmerican beliefs instead. In other words, his oath is worthless too.
---
But you can save these oath breakers from themselves by electing me, Beth Farnham, who will absolutely keep my oath instead of torturing John Joyce with another term during which he fails to uphold his oath. And I will hold Trump accountable, not only for his crimes against humanity, but against constitutional law.
---
Lastly, the Supreme Court made the wrong decision about trans women and girls in female sports. The real threat to women and girls in sports, and everywhere else, has very much been older straight white males like those listed in the EPSTEIN FILES which continue to not be fully released. I swear, that promise will be fulfilled, like when I assume office to represent us.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=65799a2af1cabecf0fd05bdd1120b79ce10c90f8b723bf0d5d13b32d5be43aa7&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=7714be75b7e4bcc33f7abff12ffabdf0&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f) !
---
| **Charity of the Week!**
---
Please donate to the Immigrant Legal Resource Center, if you can.
---
“The mission of the Immigrant Legal Resource Center (ILRC) is to work with and educate immigrants, community organizations, and the legal sector to continue to build a democratic society that values diversity and the rights of all people.”
---
You can donate here: [https://www.ilrc.org/donate](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=2b9909c5cb6668c5602b28d47423be349835ef130e4af71f8ee2b047fc0e7df0&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=47075e8b17f1db2b047fa67799554c77&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaWxyYy5vcmcvZG9uYXRl&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)
---
| | [](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=44094454e4701020b6663004d5c654d0f8fe26167fd2568835c24f8dc7e475f3&blog_id=213069660&post_id=8030&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=11ec980046331373192f5c1e3fe5dd8e&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaWxyYy5vcmcv&email_id=3dbaabf8e00ebb9394889e8d6f0df60f)
---
| **Comparing and Contrasting Votes on Legislation**
---
Check out how Joyce recently voted, how I would have voted in comparison, and why!
---
FYI – if you’re having trouble seeing this comparison in your email, please click the option for “Read on Blog” and it will load properly for you.
---

In the midst of this Constitutional Crisis, please consider reaching out to your local Democratic committees or Democratic candidates so that we can strengthen our Democracy instead of letting it slide into fascism. We don’t just #ChooseDemocracy, we choose Pennsylvania, we choose The United States of America, we choose Humanity and I am deeply glad to work along side you. Sincerely, Beth

name: Jim Schultz
subject: America is the greatest country on Earth. Period.
body:
On our 250th birthday, choose confidence over self-contempt.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/545efe8094b3/the-briefing-from-mpbc-13061549?e=baf210d431)
---
| | | | |

| |

Yesterday, on America's 250th birthday, the _Minnesota Star Tribune_ ran my column making a case that too few people in public life are willing to make without qualification: [**America is the greatest country on Earth. Period.**](https://us.list-manage.com/hxblYzHpNTe?e=baf210d431&c2id=93c61d534406ea5269257c101c1d1f83)
For decades, a reflexive self-contempt has passed for sophistication in academia, media, and politics. I grew up in rural Minnesota, where reverence for the flag was simply part of life. Somewhere along the way, that kind of open patriotism started drawing smirks instead of nods.
My argument is simple. Our sins were real — slavery, Jim Crow — but our greatness has never rested on perfection. It rests on founding ideals strong enough to force us, again and again, to become more fully who we are. We fought a civil war over them. We amended our Constitution because of them.
Now artificial intelligence is reshaping the world as profoundly as the Industrial Revolution did. The same ideals — liberty, free exercise of speech and religion, free enterprise and property rights, due process and the dignity of the individual before the state — are exactly what humanity will need next.
At 250, America isn't old. It's unfinished. The question isn't whether the next 250 years will come. It's whether we'll still believe in the country that made the first 250 possible.
I hope you'll [**read the full column**](https://us.list-manage.com/H6y1Jw0NRXo?e=baf210d431&c2id=93c61d534406ea5269257c101c1d1f83) and pass it along to someone who needs the reminder. Working with you, **Jim Schultz** President & CEOMinnesota Private Business Council **P.S.** For $100 a year, you stop watching from the sidelines.****[**Main Street Members of the Minnesota Private Business Council**](https://us.list-manage.com/rPEUR7bTFJg?e=baf210d431&c2id=93c61d534406ea5269257c101c1d1f83)**** get real-time alerts on legislation, insider polling on Minnesota's political landscape, and principled advocacy showing up in St. Paul when you can't.**** That's less than $10 a month to be part of the organized private-sector counterweight this state desperately needs — at the exact moment it needs it most.****[**Join MPBC here**](https://us.list-manage.com/JjqPN30PJ72?e=baf210d431&c2id=93c61d534406ea5269257c101c1d1f83)**.**

Donald Trump made $2.29 billion off crypto this year. The people who bought in lost $2.28 billion--almost as if they simply handed him their money, and a lot of them were working-class Americans who wanted the best for him. This week on Amped Up, [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Schuster](https://open.substack.com/users/161142740-david-schuster?utm_source=mentions) sit down with economist [Justin Wolfers](https://open.substack.com/users/495098019-justin-wolfers?utm_source=mentions), and he does the one thing nobody on cable will do: he shows you the exact math on how getting a president a few billion dollars can cost the rest of us trillions. It is not a metaphor.
He walks you through it step by step, using nothing more than a bicycle and a $400 pile of bike locks--and by the end you will never again nod along to "he's just smarter than everybody else."
This one is not a lecture, though. Wolfers proves that buying the presidency is now a straight-up profit opportunity--$2 billion in, $8 billion out, a 300 percent return-- and then, live on the show, offers to run himself if the audience will fund him. From there it careens into what money actually is, why the man whose entire job is defending the dollar is quietly holding crypto instead, why Ukraine's $20,000 drones are humiliating America's $2 million missiles, and a climate-change explainer built entirely around taxing Cliff's flatulence at the top of a Ferris wheel. You will laugh out loud. You will also understand the economy better than you did an hour earlier.
That is the whole trick--and you have to watch it to get it.

What happens when you're trapped in a scheme designed to exploit your age,
your immigration status and your financial vulnerability?

And what happens when the people controlling you decide that's still not
enough?

In this week's edition of Below the Belt(way), National Correspondent
Camaron Stevenson tells the story of Marina Lacerda—a young victim of
Jeffrey Epstein who says she was manipulated into recruiting other girls
for his network.

Now, as questions continue to swirl around the handling of the Epstein
files, Marina is speaking out. She says Epstein kept handwritten notes
documenting his dealings. So if the evidence exists, why has almost no one
else been held accountable?
